builds.changelog:
## 0.5.0
- The cape you equip in Shard Launcher now shows in-game on your own player, in third person and on your elytra (switchable).
- High-resolution capes are drawn smooth and sharp, without flicker.
- Only you see it; nothing is sent to the server.

## 0.4.0
- New menu: rail with search, favorites and six categories, a list or grid where full module names always fit, and a detail column with live previews. Search finds settings too.
- Sharp text at any size and one icon set (Lucide).
- HUD editor: snapping and guides, multi-select, align, 1-pixel nudges, undo/redo, grid, layout presets, settings next to the HUD.
- New HUD: Target HUD, Combo, Reach, Fight Recap, Cooldowns, Compass, Speed, TPS; kills, K/D and streaks in Session; better FPS, Ping, Keystrokes, Armor, Totem Counter, Item Counter and Effects.
- Low Fire for screen, ground fire and burning entities; Crosshair editor with share codes; Shield while blocking and holding; Crystal Visuals; Anchor Glow.
- GUI Scales (inventory at its own scale, hotbar, scoreboard, tab list, chat), Display (borderless fullscreen, FPS caps), Block Outline, Low Health Warning, Clean Screen, Weather and Time, Sounds, Chat.
- Quick setup: Crystal PvP Pro, Minimal or Recording in one click.
- Faster HUD (0.31 to 0.18 ms per frame). 0.3.0 configs load unchanged.

## 0.3.0
- Smooth text: Shard's settings page and HUD use Inter, the launcher's font (Vanilla font is one click away).
- The settings page looks the same at every GUI scale, with roomier spacing, anti-aliased corners and an Interface size slider.
- HUD styles: Card, Minimal or Outlined, colours, background opacity, radius, padding, shadow, alignment and label text, with global defaults and a HUD scale.
- Settings: Appearance, Keybinds with conflict warnings, profile descriptions, a wildcard server-rule editor, Export/Import and Reset all.
- New options: Crosshair hit marker and dynamic gap, Nametags scale and background, Hit Color flash duration, Low Fire preview, Crystal Optimizer highlight colour, Totem Pop message format, Explosion Optimizer particle list, Zoom scroll and cinematic camera, Keystrokes layout, Item Counter custom items.
- 0.2.0 configs migrate automatically.

## 0.2.0
- Settings page: sidebar, mod cards with toggle switches, sliding settings panel, dropdowns, colour picker, keybind capture, keyboard navigation.
- Crystal Optimizer and Anchor Optimizer: instant client-side feedback, server stays authoritative.
- Explosion Optimizer, Totem Pop Tweaks, No Death Animation, Hit Color, Low Fire, Low Shield, Fullbright, Hitboxes, Nametags, Crosshair.
- Per-server rules ("Disable on <server>") and automatic conflict detection for installed mods.
